  WHY: If run via python3 tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py, the three new test functions never execute. A future change that removes or damages the forward-merge suppressor on either path, or that removes the gate head_ref output, would pass CI silently — the tests that guard those invariants are unreachable. This defeats the purpose of a contract test suite.
